posts.text: TeamWater one year update!! The team is working so hard and making amazing progress. Really grateful to all the creators who supported this and everyone who donated. YOU are the reason TeamWater is able to save lives. Check out the video to see what’s happened so far :D

posts.text: At Feastables we’ve been obsessed with getting the 1,000,000+ kids in illegal child on cocoa farms out of child labor. Had some major breakthrus recently, give this a listen if you’re curious. Hopefully between Feastables taking charge and my reach we can make change.

1,000 Blind people helped see
100+ Houses for homeless people
100+ Cars given away
